def_en: 1) this, this one, here, which, this...that, the one...the other, another, such
1f2) on these conditions, herewith, thus provided, by, through this, for this cause, in this matter
1f4) as follows, things such as these, accordingly, to that effect, in like manner, thus and thus
1f5) from here, hence, on one side...on the other side
1f7) in spite of this, which, whence, how
kjv: he, [idiom] hence, [idiom] here, it(-self), [idiom] now, [idiom] of him, the one...the other, [idiom] than the other, ([idiom] out of) the (self) same, such (a one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side...on that side, [idiom] thus, very, which. Compare , , , .
expl: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
